scope: Reproduce and fix mobile responsive Inspector margin precedence across Canvas, draft Save, explicit Publish and public CSS; verify reset and desktop preservation.

initial_regression.before_fix: Inspector and Canvas showed 24px top margin and the saved Page Model contained responsive.mobile.margin = '24px 0 0 0'; the public node also had inline margin:24px, but computed mobile margin remained 0px due to an !important margin fallback in the public responsive stylesheet.

fixes.change: Mobile fallback margins retain their default spacing when no explicit style exists but no longer use !important, allowing inline responsive Inspector values to take effect.
The renderer-injected mobile fallback mirrors the public template's margin precedence.
Bumped the public page-renderer asset query version to 20261027-responsive-margin so browsers request the updated renderer.

lifecycle: Set mobile margin to 24px; Inspector route is responsive.set / margin and Canvas shows the edit.
Draft Save writes only the mobile Page Model override and leaves public CSS unchanged.
Editor reload preserves the mobile value; explicit Publish updates public mobile CSS to 24px.
Desktop computed margin is preserved independently.
Mobile reset restores inherited desktop margin; Undo/Redo restore the override/inherited state.
Draft reset Save leaves the published 24px mobile margin in place; separate Publish applies inheritance.
